items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a guitarist in the ABC orchestra when I was on staff at ABC. Yeah, he did that caricature of me.

ctx.x: That was done by, I can’t think of his name right at the moment, Tom somebody. He was a guitarist in the ABC orchestra when I was on staff at ABC. Yeah, he did that caricature of me. (Laughs) You know, with both of the hands going this way or something. He was very talented, he could just look at you and capture the whole thing.
